author: Peter Hughes
text:
I’ve been using Bill Dunn for septic pumping and emergency repairs for over 25 years across multiple properties, and I honestly wouldn’t call anyone else.

Bill is one of those rare people who combines professionalism, experience, and genuine personality. He always takes the time to say hello and chat for a few minutes, but when it comes to the work itself, he is extremely meticulous. The worksite is always kept clean, he’s careful with the lawn and driveway, and he takes the time to thoroughly inspect everything instead of just rushing through the job.

One thing I really appreciate is that Bill patiently explains how everything works, especially when dealing with more complex septic designs. In this kind of business, most homeowners have no idea whether corners are being cut or not, so trust matters. With Bill, I’ve always felt confident the job was done correctly and at a fair price.

He’s always on time, scheduling is never a problem, pricing is fair, and he treats people with respect. If you’re in the Prospect area and need septic work done, I would absolutely recommend Bill Dunn without hesitation.

author: Jack Perham
text: A real gentleman and highly skilled and knowledgeable. He cleans our septic and also always inspects and makes sure everything is functioning properly.  Leaves the grounds nice and clean. Lucky to have a guy like him.  Thanks Bill

author: Diane B
text: Bill Dunn Sanitation is a company I have been doing business with for years. Bill is very nice and goes above and beyond giving tips and advice. On several occasions he has come during emergencies and taken care of our issues.

author: Joao Victor Marques
text:
Called Bill for a septic clean out, was out within a few days, Bill came out himself and was super friendly, knowledgeable, courteous and all around a very nice fellow to deal with.

Took the time to answer my septic questions thoroughly and thoughtfully, super informative! Will definitely be using again and highly recommended to anyone for their septic needs.
